mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 6-month moving average indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines relative to its 6-month moving average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent monthly CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals a loss of central bank control over price stability, triggering market concerns about prolonged monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a labor market where job creation outpaces labor force growth, leading to tighter labor conditions and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS and UNRATE both rise in the current month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS and UNRATE both rise, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market expansion regime defined by sustained increases in housing starts above 2000 thousand units, consumer confidence and disposable income growth accelerate, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 2000 (thousands of units) for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST exceeds 2000 for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 118.0 indicates a contraction in manufacturing and services output, which signals weakening economic activity and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO falls below 118.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in retail sales (RSAFS) relative to its 3-month moving average indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS rises relative to its 3-month moving average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle defined by a 3-month consecutive increase in the federal funds rate above 3.5%, the market anticipates reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases for 3 consecutive months and exceeds 3.5%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS increases for 3 consecutive months and exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production (INDPRO) relative to its 6-month moving average indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic growth, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO rises relative to its 6-month moving average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
